description: Test-only case (slice M7a). The intern's evening job shift clashes with night 3 of weeks 1-5 (nights 3, 8, 13, 18, 23), and they can miss 2 shifts before the job is lost. They come back on time on nights 3 and 8 (shift missed, 1 and 2 of 2), make no plan for night 13 (they go to the shift: late, a routine cause), and come back on time on night 18: the third missed shift loses the job. From then on the shift no longer clashes with night 23. The one late return shows in the count.
